Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: six ash hounds running in narrow market alley. One native 1536x1024 landscape PNG.
Reference 1 supplies the exact accepted ash hound DESIGN. Reference 2 supplies only the approved Mangwon market's warm hanging bulbs, blank shutters and cool evening palette. Draw a quieter narrow SIDE ALLEY 2.4 m wide with simple brick and blank shop shutters, dry matte pale grey-blue floor in broad flat planes, one visible warm hanging bulb, a few plastic tubs at edges. NO dense wet reflections or fine background texture. Background lower contrast than the black monsters.
PRIORITY IS PHYSICAL SCALE. Camera is 1.6 m above ground, horizontal horizon at image y=210. Full-body generic adult, 178 cm tall, stands at left foreground from head y=130 to shoes y=950, on the very same ground depth as the leading hounds. The adult's head is above horizon. His long legs are half total body height, normal 7.5-head adult proportions. One leading hound next to him has paws at y=950 and shoulder top at y=535, HALF the adult's height, with head and ears no higher than y=420. The hound is 90 cm at shoulder. Keep these ratios: adult taller than its head/ears and about twice its shoulder height. The full adult is within the canvas, not cropped. Door behind him is 2.1 m high. No steps or raised threshold beneath the adult. Same floor, same depth, same vanishing point for everybody.
The generic adult is a near-black silhouette, with no facial details or resemblance to named cast; weight recoiling onto his left leg, right palm touching the door jamb, left arm raised across chest, head turning toward the running pack. He is in the action as a scale figure, never an overlay.
EXACTLY SIX HOUNDS TOTAL. Place them in these six spaces only: two in the foreground beside the adult, two behind those at middle depth, two behind those at far depth. No seventh animal anywhere, no tiny additional hound in the distance. The alley behind the rear pair is completely empty. Use three pairs of two, never three in a row. Six distinct heads, six torsos, six tails only. They run toward near left foreground. Two lead hounds full-body at same depth as adult, no giant close-up. Two middle hounds smaller, two rear hounds smaller again. All six heads and bodies countable, no overlap hiding a creature, all six remain clearly lean long-legged quadrupeds. Each creature retains the exact hairless smooth matte black hide, narrow deep ribcage, tucked belly, small pointed ears, long smooth thin tail, proper canine limb joints and compact four-toed paws. Coherent gallop phases, different forward reaching forelegs and folded hind hocks; at least one paw of each leader braced on ground at this instant. Tiny sharp dust strokes at contacts, restrained parallel speed marks.
Faces are entirely eyeless and noseless: plain uninterrupted black wedge above the long split mouth, no eye shadows or sockets, nose pads or nostrils. Bone-white pointed teeth in long split jaws. Violet ash #6B4C9A drifts lightly from narrow dorsal cracks only; no fur, armour, whole-scene fog or glare.
Warm-white bulb above-left is key, cool blue evening fill. Keep figures as large clean hand-inked black masses and hard cel shadow shapes; no glossy grey modelling. Calm quiet space at upper left; cropped tub low right as foreground. One shared perspective, distant feet higher and figures smaller at the same rate.
The reference images show only the characters' design (face, hair, clothes, colours, props). Do not copy their standing poses or front-facing angles: pose, camera and expression come only from the scene text.
Ash hounds: lean, long-legged, wolf-sized hounds 90 cm at the shoulder with smooth black bodies, no eyes and no nose, a long split jaw of white bone-like teeth, ribs pressing through, and cracks along the back leaking violet ash.
COUNT THE ANIMALS BEFORE COMPLETING: two foreground plus two middle plus two rear equals six; do not add a seventh. One full-height adult, no alpha, no text.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
records.reason: Correct six-hound count and useful scale, but the cropped lower-right tubs have optical depth-of-field blur forbidden by the style guide.
